common_design.covariate_rule: Start with intercept, old indicator, male indicator, DCD indicator for Kedlian, and mean log raw UMI where declared. Retain old and depth in their declared models; add sex and donor type only when observed, nonconstant, and full rank. Any omitted aliased/unavailable covariate is recorded in the model table. Require full column rank and at least two residual degrees of freedom; otherwise the unit is untestable. Perez models use old plus mean log raw UMI; sex is not added as a per-donor field because it is unavailable.
common_design.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg separately by assay, endpoint, donor set, and model. Gene-level BH families are assay-wide across all tested cell-type-by-gene combinations, not separate within-cell-type families. Conventional and expression-matched-null P1 p-values have separate families.
common_design.independent_replication_label: blocked because Kedlian reused Perez and individual disjointness is not proven

Kedlian.input: Public raw cells+nuclei H5AD, layers/counts only for expression counts; released obs annotations and manifest donor mapping.
Kedlian.count_gate: Stream every stored layers/counts value and require finite, nonnegative, integer-valued float32 before aggregation. Any violation stops all outcomes.
Kedlian.primary_donor_set: Adult released groups: exclude donor 470BR in the 17-20 band; do not assign numeric ages or band midpoints.
Kedlian.sensitivity_donor_set: All donors, adding 470BR under the released young label; declared before outcomes.
Kedlian.primary_model: old + mean_log_umi, with sex and donor_type included under the common full-rank rule.
Kedlian.unadjusted_sensitivity_model: old only, with sex and donor_type excluded and no depth term.

P1_transport.donor_summary: Mean of per-cell log1p(CPM) values per donor and released cell type; up mean minus down mean.
P1_transport.null: 200 expression-decile-matched random-signature draws without replacement, excluding P1 genes, seed 20261105; centered two-sided empirical p=(1+extreme)/(201).

donor_CLR_composition.counts: All released known cell labels in each assay define the composition universe, including zero counts.
donor_CLR_composition.depth_adjustment: mean_log_umi computed over all annotated cells contributing to the donor composition

donor_pseudobulk_gene_models.summary: Sum raw counts by donor and released cell type, then log1p(CPM) using the donor-cell-type total raw UMI.
donor_pseudobulk_gene_models.gene_filter: At least 10 summed counts across included donors and detection in at least two included donors; filter is independent of age outcomes.
donor_pseudobulk_gene_models.multiplicity: Assay-wide BH across all finite-standard-error cell-type-by-gene tests within each donor set and model.

Hellinger_displacement.reference: Released young group within assay and cell type; primary excludes 470BR. Pool raw counts after technical-gene exclusion and leave the evaluated young donor out (cross-fitting). Old donors use all eligible young donors.
Hellinger_displacement.cell_filter: At least 1500 raw UMI and positive nontechnical UMI.
Hellinger_displacement.technical_exclusions: MT-, RPL/RPS/MRPL/MRPS prefixes and XIST, TSIX, DDX3Y, EIF2S3Y, UTY, KDM5D.
Hellinger_displacement.floors: At least two eligible young reference donors, 20 qualifying cells per scored donor, at least 50 cross-fitted reference cells for every donor, six scored donors total and two per group.
Hellinger_displacement.label: NONNUMERIC_AGE_GROUP_SENSITIVITY; age bands are never converted to numeric ages.
Hellinger_displacement.otherwise: Mark untestable with the failed floor; do not report a null.

Perez.input: The 17 public per-donor filtered 10x H5 files with int32 matrix/data; no bulk count table and no FASTQ.
Perez.count_gate: Stream every stored count and require finite nonnegative integer values; verify 134486 released filtered nuclei across 17 files.
Perez.primary_model: Released Old versus Young group plus mean_log_umi, full rank with at least two residual degrees of freedom.
Perez.exact_age_sensitivity: Exact age per 10 years plus mean_log_umi; numeric ages are used only where released. This sensitivity is declared before outcomes.
Perez.annotation_gate: Seek released per-nucleus annotations in primary/public processed objects. Do not infer or invent annotations.

if_annotations_unavailable.allowed: Whole-nucleus donor summaries and donor-pseudobulk gene models, explicitly confounded by changing cell-type composition.
if_annotations_unavailable.P1_transport: blocked_or_confounded; no whole-nucleus signature transport claim

Perez.if_annotations_available: Apply the common donor/cell floors and the Kedlian endpoint definitions where compatible, but keep study, tissue, assay, and multiplicity families separate.
Perez.bulk_72_man_arm: excluded from all single-nucleus inference and not downloaded

cross_cohort_comparison.allowed: Only compatible donor-level estimands and genuinely harmonized released cell-type labels, with cohort-specific estimates side by side.
cross_cohort_comparison.not_allowed: Pooling donors or p-values, meta-analysis, counting Perez twice, or calling either analysis independent replication.
cross_cohort_comparison.different_tissues: Kedlian intercostal muscle and Perez vastus lateralis remain a cross-cohort comparison, not a direct tissue-matched replication.
